name: video_remove_background
description: Cuts the subject out of a clip. Default output is VP9 .webm with real transparency; pick X264 .mp4 only if the consumer cannot read webm, as it cannot carry an alpha channel — set `backgroundColor` to a hex instead. Max 20s / 200 MB / 512 frames. Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

backgroundColor.description: `transparent` or a `#RRGGBB` hex to flatten onto. Use a hex when the output is .mp4.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation. Max 20s, 200 MB, 512 frames at 30fps.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

model.description: Segmentation model. `Portrait` for people, `Matting` for fine edges like hair.

outputMaskVideo.description: Return the alpha matte instead of the cut-out subject.
